# Astronomical 0.2.53
## What's new
- **Menu bar progress now shows during Qwen image generation and for embedding models.** Astronomical now reports live progress in the macOS menu bar — `Image 25% -> 50% -> 75%` while a Qwen Image 2.1 image renders, plus equivalent status for embedding models. Previously the menu bar froze with no progress while a Qwen or embedding model was loaded. This closes [#786](https://github.com/aosama/astronomical/issues/786).
## Compatibility
- Apple Silicon Macs, macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) and later. - No configuration or API migration from 0.2.52.
## Your state is preserved
- Your model RAM ceiling, model library, and prompt cache are unchanged by this update.
## Signed and verified distribution
- Distributed as a Developer ID-signed app built with the Hardened Runtime for `arm64`. - Downloaded through the signed Apple Notarization process and stapled. - Updates are delivered through the signed Sparkle feed. Verify the download by checking its SHA-256 against the digest recorded in this release's manifest.
